checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/layer3-smart-contracts and extract exact in-scope contract addresses, Git repo URLs, commit hashes, and any out-of-scope items or testing rules.
Clone the official Layer3 Solidity repository at the pinned commit and identify the core contracts directory (e.g., src/, contracts/).
Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py against the cloned repo root, enabling recon + full static (Slither/Aderyn) + symbolic (Halmos) + Mythril passes.
Triage Slither/Aderyn findings for access-control, reentrancy, and unchecked external calls.
Execute targeted Halmos symbolic tests on functions handling staking, reward distribution, and cross-contract calls.
Manually review business logic for oracle trust assumptions, role escalation paths, and improper state transitions not covered by automated tools.
Verify any candidate issues on a local fork or testnet using the exact deployed bytecode and constructor arguments from scope.
Draft submission with reproduction steps, minimal PoC, root-cause, and impact rating that matches Hackenproof severity and payout tiers.
Submit report through the Hackenproof platform UI, attaching only the allowed artifacts and respecting their disclosure policy.
